privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your tasks and what Dhakerni learns about you stay on this device.
privacy.server: For reminders when the app is closed, our server keeps only your push address, an anonymous ID, the reminder time and a short title. It is encrypted and deleted right after the reminder fires.

task.reorderHelp: Press space to pick up, arrow keys to move, space to drop.
task.assumedHint: Learned from you. Tap to change.

toast.unclear: Couldn't tell the time. Pick one of the options.

voice.denied: Microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type instead.
voice.unsupported: Voice needs a secure connection (https) and a microphone. You can still type.
voice.failed: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again or type instead.
voice.tooShort: Too short. Hold the mic while you speak.
voice.noTask: No task found in that. Try rephrasing.

capture.fallback: Couldn't understand that, so it was saved as written.
capture.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
capture.transcribeFailed: Couldn't process the recording. Try again or type it.
